lines.t: 🎵 When someone has done you wrong, do not let it linger on 🎵
For if you hold it in your heart, bitterness can take its part
So settle the matter quickly, bring it before the Lord
The first stitch to mender it is the simple truth, I'm sorry
Leave your adversary a gift, place it gently at their door
You may win their heart again
Blessed are the poor in spirit
You see, this is what happened to me
I forgave my precious sister and the Lord has set me free
Now I do not look back
I place her in His hands
The first stitch to mender it
Is the simple truth, I'm sorry
Leave your adversary a gift
Place it gently at their door
You may win their heart again
Blessed are the poor in spirit
It is no more a burden for my heart to carry
The weight is lifted off me
This sin cannot take root
My soul is now at peace
For now I bless my sister
And hope someday we'll meet
And maybe at His table
He will save her a seat
So praise the Lord forever, give Him all the glory
He helped me overcome
And write this final story
